[#hash-backends-of-turboshake]
.Who implements `digests::turboshake_128`, `digests::turboshake_256` (RFC 9861)
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]
|===
| Function | Backend | The program's Jamfile names | Targets | Hmacs | Constant time

| `digests::turboshake_128`
| `sodium`
| `/third_party//sodium`
| native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
| -
| not stated

| `digests::turboshake_256`
| `sodium`
| `/third_party//sodium`
| native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
| -
| not stated
|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `digests::turboshake_128` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::turboshake_256` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

One backend, `sodium`: the types take no backend.
